title: "University Profiles <span class='zh-inline'>(高校一览)</span>"

Every project in this book comes from a real course at a real university. This section introduces the fourteen institutions behind the 32 projects — their background, the people associated with computing there, and the courses that shaped the assignments you will read.

> 本书的每个项目都来自一所真实高校的真实课程。本节介绍 32 个项目背后的十四所学校：它们的背景、与计算机科学相关的人物，以及塑造了这些作业的课程。

## On the identifiers (关于标识)

Four schools use logo files redistributed by an MIT-licensed open course-map project. The remaining schools use a **typographic identifier** generated by `scripts/gen-university-wordmarks.py` — an abbreviation and name, never an official crest or seal. This is deliberate: university marks are trademarks, and this book is an educational reference, not a university publication. Each profile page links to primary sources for its factual claims.

> 四所学校使用 MIT 许可的开放课程地图项目中转载的校徽文件；其余学校使用脚本生成的**文字标识**（缩写 + 校名），而非官方校徽。校徽是商标，本书是教育参考而非学校官方出版物。每个页面的事实都附有一手来源链接。
